title: Watch Colin Cowherd and Jason McIntyre debate Sam Darnold's recent struggles - The Herd with Colin Cowherd

 The Herd with Colin Cowherd · FS1 · Aired Fri, Oct 23 · 3m 20s 
 Watch Now Already a subscriber? Sign-In Colin Cowherd and Jason McIntyre analyze Sam Darnold's recent turnover issues with the Seattle Seahawks. They debate the public and media reaction to his performance and discuss how crucial a reliable run game is to helping elite quarterbacks succeed in the NFL.
